text:
jamal: Heads up — Acuity's procurement just sent a bundle. They can't get an exec signature on the MSA, asking to sign the order form only + DPA. Also requesting: delegated signer (Head of Procurement on behalf of EU subsidiary), PO with net45, and use of their e-sign vendor. Can legal confirm whether we can accept delegated signer + third-party e-sign?

kate_procurement: They said the delegate will sign in DocuSign and we should accept a PO as the commercial commitment. Their AP wants an invoice to a different remit address. I asked for a sample PO and the proposed signer name.

jamal: attaching their proposed signature block and DPA redlines (link): https://acquire-acuity.example/attachments/acq-dpa-redline.pdf

jamal: proposed sig block (from their counsel):
```
For Acuity Ltd (on behalf of Acuity EU Subsidiary)
By: ____________________
Name: Jane Procurement
Title: Head of Procurement
Date: ____________________
```

ellie_legal: Quick Qs: (1) Is there an existing signed MSA with them? (2) Are they asking to replace our MSA or run order form under our standard MSA terms?

alex_aex: No signed MSA yet. They want order form + DPA only to start the POC. If legal allows, sales prefers keep it lightweight to not blow the deal. Pricing note: they asked about monthly billing vs annual; procurement prefers annual invoice with net45.

ellie_legal: OK high-level: we can sometimes accept order-form-only deals for small POCs, but we need the following before accepting a delegated signer:
- Evidence of signatory authority (POA or corporate resolution) OR the PO must explicitly reference the contractual terms + identify counterparty entity
- E-sign vendor must provide an audit trail (DocuSign/AdobeSign OK). We don't accept proprietary/obscure vendors without audit proof.
- DPA redlines: I'll review but we cannot accept unlimited liability, and we need to limit audit rights to scoped compliance audits (or provide logs).

kate_procurement: I'll ask them to upload the PO, signatory authority doc, and to use DocuSign if they can. Also asked for remit address and tax ID.

jamal: Customer replied: they can provide a PO (pdf), signatory authority (signed letter from GC), and will use DocuSign. They flagged KMS requirement in DPA (they want customer-managed KMS for encryption keys). They said it's a blocker for hosted.

ellie_legal: KMS: we can't support customer-managed KMS for hosted Redwood API. We can offer Dedicated or Private deployments which support customer KMS/HSM and different controls. I'll add that to the redline comment.

ellie_legal: I'll take the DPA redline now. High level requested changes I see:
- Remove or cap indemnity/limitation buckets (we'll propose a cap tied to fees)
- Narrow audit rights (replace intrusive audit with log access + SOC report)
- Clarify subprocessors and add 30-day notice for additions
- KMS: decline for hosted, offer Dedicated/Private path

alex_aex: Can we accept PO net45? Finance prefers net30 but we can be flexible for this strategic POC.

kate_procurement: Finance needs to approve net45 for deals > $100k. This POC is under that threshold; we can sign net45 in the order form.

jamal: Action list:
- jamal: request PO, signatory authority doc, DocuSign envelope (ASAP)
- ellie_legal: produce redline + comment set for DPA and order form (48h target)
- kate_procurement: capture remit address, tax ID, and PO number; share billing template
- alex_aex: lock-in pricing and confirm invoice cadence with customer

jamal: pinging customer now. @ellie_legal can you confirm 48h turnaround? :pray:

ellie_legal: Yes, will try for 48 business hours. If they push non‑standard broad liability, escalate to GC.

legal-bot: NOTE: DPA redline uploaded to Legal Drive: https://legal.example/redlines/1918002222-acuity-dpa-redline.docx (automated upload)

alex_aex: Perfect. Once we have the PO + DocuSign envelope + signer authority, I'll route to finance for invoicing.

jamal: Customer just sent DocuSign envelope id=0a1b2c. They also attached the PO (pdf) and the corporate resolution scanned. Forwarding to @ellie_legal and @kate_procurement.

kate_procurement: Received. I'll validate PO fields against our billing template. If anything missing I'll request a corrected PO.

ellie_legal: Reviewing the docs now. If the corporate resolution is clear and DocuSign audit trail shows signatory email & IP, we can accept the delegated signature. I'll post our redline comments in the doc and request removal of unlimited liability and an alternate audit clause.

jamal: Thanks all — will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
